notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario exercises clause 4's application participation behavior using only public IEEE 1516.1-2025 services: it creates two federation executions, joins multiple federates to each, and reuses one RTIambassador after resignation in the other execution. The adapter supplies the provider, baseline FOM, logical-time selection, and endpoint. Passing this scenario is API-level test evidence, not a claim of conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Connect, Create Federation Execution, Join Federation Execution, Resign Federation Execution, Destroy Federation Execution, and Disconnect
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_application_multiple_executions_catch2.cpp::One application may join multiple federates across multiple federation executions
